_comment: Device rename map (ruling 2.2). THE single source of truth: every tool, doc and generated artefact derives its names from here, never by typing. NMOS50 read as 50 V and NMOS12 as 1.2 V; the circuits libraries already use 1V8/3V3/5V0, so the devices adopt it, with V explicit everywhere.
_token_rule: Match with (?<![A-Za-z0-9])<old>(?![A-Za-z0-9]) so that composites rename too -- NMOS18_INT, VTH_NMOS18, Z_VTH_NMOS18, c_NMOS18, KP_NDMOS20_STAT, TC_KP_NDMOS20 -- while NDMOS20 never matches inside NDMOS200 (the next character is a digit) and NMOS20 never matches inside DNMOS20 (the previous character is a letter). A plain   would fail: _ is a word character, so  NMOS18  does not match NMOS18_INT.
